name: payment
title: Payment
description: Provider-agnostic payments for Lunora — Stripe-first checkout, metered usage tracking, entitlement checks, billing portal, and subscription queries built on @lunora/payment. Scaffolds the checkout / track / check / portal / subscriptions / webhook functions. The provider adapter is wired into createShardDO (see docs).
docs: Wire the payment adapter into your Worker entry's createShardDO({ payment: (env) => ({ adapter: createStripeAdapter({ client: new Stripe(env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, { httpClient: Stripe.createFetchHttpClient() }), webhookSecret: env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET }), authorize: (ref) => ref === ctx.auth.userId, entitlements: { plans: { pro: { features: ['export'], limits: { api_calls: 1000 }, priceIds: ['price_xxx'] } } } }) }) — the adapter reads STRIPE_SECRET_KEY + STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET from env. Then add the POST /payment/webhook HTTP route (see the generated file header for the snippet), run `lunora codegen`, and set the secrets in .dev.vars (locally) and wrangler secret put for production.

envVars.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
envVars.description: Stripe secret key (test mode: sk_test_...). Obtain from the Stripe dashboard.

envVars.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envVars.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...). Set in the Stripe dashboard for your /payment/webhook endpoint.
